2026 · Python · Ollama · uv · REPL

Local Ollama HarnessLocal Ollama Harness

终端里的本地代码助手A local coding assistant in your terminal

用一句自然语言在终端里创建、查看、修改并运行 Python 文件，全程只连本机 Ollama，默认 qwen2.5-coder:3b。所有文件读写与执行都限制在 sandbox/ 目录内，越界路径直接拒绝。Create, read, edit and run Python files from a plain-language prompt. Everything talks to local Ollama only (qwen2.5-coder:3b by default), and file access is confined to sandbox/.

技术栈Stack

  • Python
  • Ollama
  • uv
  • REPL

亮点Highlights

  1. 自然语言任务 → 工具调用 → 最终答案Plain-language task, tool calls, then a final answer

  2. /reset /quiet /tools 等 REPL 命令REPL commands like /reset, /quiet and /tools

  3. 路径越界直接拒绝，只动 sandbox/Out-of-scope paths are refused; only sandbox/ is touched

  4. 断网可用，不产生云端费用Works offline and costs nothing in the cloud
